id: title:Gilbert09:map legacy bigquery type names in alter table ddl

review.posthog_relevance: BigQuery warehouse ingestion compatibility and query planning
review.reason: Adds a guard and normalization for BigQuery's lack of DDL alias support for standard SQL FLOAT type, preventing ingestion failures and compatibility issues.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on the supplied observation; actual runtime behavior and test assertions are not independently verified. No evidence of broader systemic impact or adoption.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires a score. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a mapping and a guard against BigQuery's lack of a DDL alias for the standard SQL type FLOAT. P1.F1.H1 adds _REPORTED_TYPE and _DDL_TYPES_WITHOUT_ALIAS. P1.F3.H1 uses _STANDARD_BIGQUERY_TYPE to normalize field types, and P1.F2.H5 adds a test asserting BadRequest for an unsupported DDL type.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent BigQuery ingestion failures when warehouse tables use standard SQL types without legacy aliases, and could help compatibility with BigQuery's strict DDL requirements.
